notes:
v1.19.4 Release:
- Exported and joined videos are about half the size, still in HD: a 3 hour series that came out at 9 GB is now about 5 GB. The export used to give every video the same high bitrate, however low the source's was; now it follows the source, with at least 3500k at 1080p and 2000k at 720p (tested: the picture and the Khmer subtitles look the same as before)
- Join into one video no longer re-encodes a whole series because of one odd part on Intel and AMD PCs: only that part is re-encoded to match, and the rest are joined as they are, much faster. Before, this only worked on NVIDIA
- A video whose frame rate was read as double (50 instead of 25) is exported at its real frame rate, instead of with every frame doubled

New in v1.19.3:
- Gemini Web Router: Gmails start again. Google changed which sign-in cookies Gemini accepts, so every Gmail was sent to Google's sign-in page and showed "could not start: TimeoutError", with or without a proxy. The Router now sends the cookies Google asks for, and keeps Gemini's own copy of them when you sign in
- A Gmail that could not start (a proxy that stopped working, a short network drop, a timeout) is now tried again by itself after 2, 4 and 8 minutes, then every 15 minutes. Before, it stayed stuck until you restarted DR Dubber
- A Gmail that Google sends to its sign-in page now shows as signed out, so DR Dubber brings it back from its Chrome profile instead of changing its proxy for nothing
- Clearer message when Gemini is slow to answer: "Timed out: Gemini did not answer within 45 s through the proxy" (or "from this PC") instead of just "TimeoutError"

New in v1.19.2:
- Smart Task Split: API Keys transcribe audio with exact timestamps, while Gmail Web Router accounts translate subtitles and refactor dialogue (saving your 1,500 daily API quota across 10,000s of lines). Both automatically act as failover backups for each other
- Low Memory Mode: tabs with 500-1,000+ subtitles use hundreds of megabytes less RAM: idle audio streams are pruned, tab switches pre-warm only the first 20 clips with on-demand streaming, and waveform canvas texture memory is immediately reclaimed on clear
- Voice Stability & Micro-Staggering: 100ms micro-staggering eliminates Edge-TTS WebSocket drops under heavy parallel load; empty lines fast-fail without retrying
- Khmer TTS Normalization Standards: added pronunciation normalization for spelled-out numbers, decimals (ចុច), repetition mark expansion (ៗ), currencies, and phonetic brand transliterations
- Bounded VoxCPM2 Reference Cache: caches up to 5 reference speaker clips in memory to accelerate speech cloning without memory leaks

New in v1.19.1:
- Generate audio is fast again: when Microsoft's voice service turns a line away ("No audio was received"), only that line waits a few seconds and tries again, while the other lines keep going. In v1.19.0 every line stopped for 30-60 seconds each time, so voicing was 2-6 times slower and many lines showed "Retry" or timed out
- In a test of 300 lines, every line was voiced and only 1 showed a retry

New in v1.19.0:
- Runs well on a small PC: DR Dubber looks at how much memory and how many CPU threads the PC has, and on a small PC it does fewer things at the same time (one export, one subtitle search and three Transcribe tabs at once), so the PC stays smooth instead of freezing
- New in Settings > General > Performance: see what DR Dubber found on your PC and the limits it uses. Auto picks them by itself; you can also choose Light, Standard or Strong
- When the PC is short of free memory, the next big job (an export, Isolate BGM, Remove music, a subtitle search) waits for the one before it to finish, instead of slowing the whole PC down
- Transcribe starts fewer video cuts at the same time, so many tabs transcribed together no longer make the PC crawl
- A PC with 12 GB of memory or more keeps about the same limits as before

New in v1.18.2:
- Dub Whole Series: when Microsoft's voice service turns lines away ("No audio was received"), DR Dubber now sends fewer lines at once and waits a moment, then speeds up again, instead of retrying every line over and over. Fewer lines end with the red warning, and less time goes to waiting

New in v1.18.1:
- Gemini Web Router installs on any PC: when Python 3.10 or newer is not on the PC, it uses the Python that comes with DR Dubber, instead of stopping with "Python 3.10 or newer was not found on this PC"
- Updating the Router's library now reports the new version correctly

New in v1.18.0:
- Gemini Web Router: in Dub Whole Series each ready Gmail gets its own tab again, and Transcribe, Transcribe All Tabs and Dub Whole Series can start with Gmails only, no API key
- Stopping a job frees its Gmail at once; a Gmail out of credits waits until Google's reset time instead of 30 minutes; non-Chinese videos are no longer asked twice
- New "Work" panel shows which answers came from Gmails or API keys, and why a Gmail was passed over
- The Router page is rebuilt: readable in the light theme, one mode switch, summary tiles and one menu per Gmail. Updating its library tests it first and rolls back if it fails
- Check limits looks at every model a job would use on each key, not just the chosen one, and shows the answer under each key
- Exports use the GPU by default (Auto), and fall back to the CPU when no GPU encoder works
- API Saver is on unless you switch it off; AI Refactor and Rewrite use all your API keys, not just the first
- Series are faster: voices for up to 8 tabs at once, and lines without audio are voiced before export
- Fixed: "Get a key from AI Studio" crashed every time
- Fixed: VoxCPM2 server could be left running after a quick stop and start, and now says why it stopped
- BGM cache is kept under 4 GB, and the log file is much smaller
- DR Router PRO is removed (Gemini Web Router stays)

Also new since v1.6.0:
- v1.17.0: Gemini Web Router, no silent subtitles, each episode its own tab, honest key limits, faster exports (v1.17.1: transcribe fast again with many keys)
- v1.16.0: Edge voices say the words they kept getting wrong correctly, fixed automatically
- v1.15.0: voices start with their subtitle however far Transcribe drifts, a notice on screen is not read as the subtitles, no double voices
- v1.14.0: one voice per character however Gemini spells them, Remove music from BGM, NVIDIA decoding for exports
- v1.13.0: series survives a power cut or lost Wi-Fi, every subtitle voiced, export colours match the preview
- v1.12.0: one voice per character, faster blur exports, overlays and ads removed
- v1.11.0: VoxCPM2 lines said like the actor, 4x faster lines, better Khmer reading
- v1.10.0: the export matches the editor
- v1.9.0: emotions for imported SRTs and on the voice pill, VoxCPM2 Khmer voice, series export folder
- v1.8.0: VoxCPM2 voice capture and voice groups, Fix Rushed Lines, Khmer pronouns
- v1.7.0: Khmer interface, Join into one video, Gemini model changes
